title: Avenoxrtp
description: Modern RTP plugin for Paper/Spigot featuring safe random teleportation, optimized chunk loading, and smooth performance.
body:
# **AvenoxRTP**

## **Overview**

AvenoxRTP is a professional-grade Random Teleport plugin built from the ground up for performance, safety, and total configurability. Designed to compete with the best RTP plugins on the market, it focuses entirely on doing one thing exceptionally well — getting players to safe, random locations fast, with **zero reward systems, zero economy gimmicks, and zero bloat.**



## 🌐 Links

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Server-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/DH3xfGHDFt)

[![YouTube](https://img.shields.io/badge/YouTube-@FinalStrikerrr-FF0000?style=for-the-badge&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/@FinalStrikerrr)




## **Features**

### **🌍 Multi-World Support**

* Unlimited configured worlds — Overworld, Nether, End, or any custom world
* Per-world settings: cooldown, price, radius, permissions, enable/disable
* **Two border modes**: `FOLLOW_WORLD_BORDER` (auto-detects the vanilla world border) or `CUSTOM_RADIUS` (your own bounds)

### **🛡️ Safe Location System**

* Full hazard detection: lava, fire, cactus, magma, powder snow, void, cave pockets, and more
* Configurable safety rules with extra unsafe-block overrides
* Min/max Y-level bounds per search
* **Main-thread-safe chunk loading** — every chunk check happens correctly on Paper’s main thread, so destinations always render properly with no invisible terrain or lag spikes

### **⚡ Performance**

* **Location pre-caching** — safe spots are pre-calculated in the background so teleports feel instant
* Batched, tick-friendly search loop that avoids main-thread stalls
* Built to support **500+ concurrent players** with minimal TPS impact
* Persistent chunk tickets keep destination chunks loaded through teleport

### **🎨 GUI Customization**

* Every slot, material, name, lore line, sound, enchant glow, and custom model data is editable via `gui.yml`
* Built-in placeholders for cooldown, distance, and player stats inside item lore
* Border/filler decoration support for a polished, professional look out of the box

### **⏱️ Countdown System**

* Configurable countdown timer with live **BossBar**, **Title**, and **ActionBar** updates
* Per-tick sound effects (fully configurable)
* **Smart cancellation** — countdown cancels on move, damage, command use, or disconnect (each independently toggleable)
* Particle effects on success/failure

### **🔌 Automatic Hooks**

AvenoxRTP works completely standalone on a fresh Paper server. If you install any of the plugins below, it automatically detects and hooks them with no configuration needed — and silently skips them if they’re absent.

| Category             | Supported Plugins                                                                                     |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Economy**          | Vault                                                                                                 |
| **Placeholders**     | PlaceholderAPI (13 built-in placeholders)                                                             |
| **Permissions**      | LuckPerms                                                                                             |
| **Claim Protection** | WorldGuard, GriefPrevention, GriefDefender, Towny, Lands, Residence, KingdomsX, HuskTowns, RedProtect |

All integrations use pure reflection internally, meaning **no external plugin jar is required to compile or run the plugin.**

### **📊 Statistics**

* Tracks total, successful, and failed teleports
* Per-world usage breakdown
* Average search time tracking
* Per-player lifetime teleport counts

### **🎛️ Permissions**

* Tiered cooldown permissions (`avenoxrtp.cooldown.<seconds>`)
* Bypass permissions for cooldown and economy
* Per-world access permissions
* Admin-only commands locked behind dedicated nodes

### **🧩 Commands**

```text
/rtp                  → Opens the RTP GUI
/rtp gui              → Opens the RTP GUI
/rtp reload           → Reloads all configuration files
/rtp stats            → View server-wide RTP statistics
/rtp debug            → View live debug information
/rtp version          → Plugin & integration info
/rtp force <player>   → Force-teleport a player (admin)
/rtp biome <biome>    → Teleport into a specific biome
```

### **⚙️ Configuration**

Four fully documented config files:

* **`config.yml`** — worlds, cooldowns, economy, search behavior, feedback, sounds, particles
* **`gui.yml`** — every visual element of the GUI
* **`messages.yml`** — every player-facing message, fully customizable
* **`worlds.yml`** *(generated)* — per-world rules

---

## **Compatibility**

| Requirement               | Version                       |
| ------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| **Server Software**       | Paper 1.21+, Purpur, or Folia |
| **Java**                  | Java 21                       |
| **Required Dependencies** | **None**                      |

---

## **Why AvenoxRTP**

Unlike plugins padded with crates, tokens, and streak rewards, AvenoxRTP stays focused on what an RTP plugin should actually do: **find safe locations quickly, teleport reliably, and stay out of the way.** Every feature exists to improve performance, safety, or customization — nothing else.
